result.summary: Do not ship: Save Settings now omits every General field and silently overwrites saved configuration with defaults.

findings.title: Keep General controls associated with the Save Settings form
findings.body: The new General form ends before the form containing Save Settings and has no submit button. Removing the explicit form associations means clicking Save Settings submits only instance fields. save_settings (triggarr/web/routes.py:531–539) interprets missing General fields as defaults, then persists them at lines 608–612. For example, an existing hard_max_per_cycle=10 becomes 0 (unlimited), skip_unreleased=true becomes false, and max_history_rows=10000 becomes 1000. General edits are also discarded. Previously these controls were included in the same submission.
findings.recommendation: Restore id="settings-form" on the submitting form and form="settings-form" on every General control. Verify the existing test_general_fields_submit_with_the_save_settings_form regression test passes.

next_steps: Restore the shared form association before shipping.
